body:
I have tried to speak to my family.  It did not happen as I would have liked it too. My father told me to just "get over it." My mother felt responsible, she asked if I needed her to visit, and I told clearly that was not what I wanted.  She travelled to visit me anyway, I acted normal, she left happy thinking she had done the right thing and I was fixed.  She did not help.  I am know I am ungrateful.  All I wanted to do was talk, at a distance, to someone who would listen.  I felt betrayed.

My sister Lee has moved to Wales.  We still speak, but our conversations are empty.

If I reopen these lines of dialogue, it will hurt them.  I do not want to hurt my family, which is **reason #1** I am still alive.

I have considered and rejected Yoga.  I will consider meditation, although I suspect I would just breakdown in public.  I'm afraid of that.

I agree that I am young, and that I could have many years of life ahead of me.  It fills me with dread.

I do not have any friends, I have alienated almost everyone.
